name: atlas-protocol
description: Local Atlas Protocol validator and TypeScript package

scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-protocol-dist.cjs && node dist/scripts/generate-go.js
scripts.verify: npm run prebuild && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node dist/scripts/export-schema-bundle.js --check && node dist/scripts/generate-go.js --check && node scripts/copy-protocol-dist.cjs && node dist/scripts/verify.js && npm run verify:go
scripts.verify:standalone: npm run build && ATLAS_PROTOCOL_ROOT=dist/protocol node dist/scripts/verify.js
